baseline_scope_expansions.title: Webhook bodies are buffered before their size checks
baseline_scope_expansions.evidence: Each route accepts an arbitrary nonempty signature header and calls request.text() before enforcing its 1,000,000-character limit or verifying the signature. Next 16.4's default proxyClientMaxBodySize truncates proxy clones near 10 MiB; it does not reject the request early.
baseline_scope_expansions.recommendation: Set a hard byte limit and request controls at the operator reverse proxy, avoid global proxy body cloning for API paths that do not need it, and read webhook raw bytes through a streaming cap before signature verification.
baseline_scope_expansions.formal_exclusion: Denial of service and resource exhaustion are excluded from the CSO findings count.

availability_findings.title: Multi-frame WebP screenshots cause large Sharp CPU amplification
availability_findings.attack_prerequisite: A current catalog-capable staff session or agent key and a private import slug.
availability_findings.exploit_scenario: Submit a valid WebP under the existing byte and dimension limits with a very large frame count. The exact metadata and conversion path processes the container for about 21 seconds while emitting a one-pixel PNG.
availability_findings.safe_proof: A 5,005,614-byte WebP containing 100,000 1x1 frames took 7,279.66 ms for metadata and 14,120.41 ms for conversion on this host. The output was one 90-byte PNG.
availability_findings.impact: Parallel accepted requests can consume image worker and CPU capacity and delay unrelated application work.
availability_findings.recommendation: Reject metadata.pages values other than 1 before conversion and add per-key request and decode concurrency limits.
availability_findings.formal_exclusion: CSO hard exclusions 1 and 3 cover denial of service and CPU exhaustion.

availability_findings.title: Anonymous missing-content requests force synchronous SQLite writes
availability_findings.attack_prerequisite: None; arbitrary remote requests to nonexistent clean listing or article paths reach the path.
availability_findings.exploit_scenario: Send unique missing listing or article paths. Each miss opens an immediate transaction; after 500 paths each new request also evicts a row, keeping synchronous write pressure constant.
availability_findings.safe_proof: Ten thousand direct calls with unique paths executed ten thousand immediate transactions in 392.89 ms against an in-memory database and retained exactly 500 rows.
availability_findings.impact: A cheap 404 flood becomes serialized database writes and disk churn on the same SQLite service used by catalog, auth, audit, notification, and payment state.
availability_findings.recommendation: Remove immediate writes from the request path. Aggregate or sample misses in memory, flush them in bounded batches, and apply edge rate limits to missing-content paths.
availability_findings.formal_exclusion: CSO hard exclusions 1 and 3 cover denial of service and resource exhaustion.

hardening_gaps.title: No repository-owned global browser security-header policy
hardening_gaps.condition: Relevant only when the external reverse proxy does not add equivalent CSP, frame, HSTS, referrer, permissions, and content-type policies.
hardening_gaps.recommendation: Define one tested policy in next.config.ts or document and test the exact reverse-proxy policy; disable X-Powered-By.

hardening_gaps.title: Weak BETTER_AUTH_SECRET values warn but do not fail closed
hardening_gaps.condition: The manual requests a strong secret, but runtime configuration accepts weak nonempty values.
hardening_gaps.recommendation: Reject production secrets shorter than 32 random bytes or below the documented strength before creating the auth instance.

hardening_gaps.title: Backups verify integrity but not provenance
hardening_gaps.condition: An attacker who can modify backup storage can replace data, the bundled billing key, and the unhashed manifest together.
hardening_gaps.recommendation: Authenticate backup manifests with an independently stored key or immutable storage control.

hardening_gaps.title: Container confinement stops at non-root and loopback binding
hardening_gaps.condition: This raises post-compromise and resource-exhaustion impact but does not create the initial compromise.
hardening_gaps.recommendation: Drop capabilities, set no-new-privileges, use a read-only root with explicit writable mounts, and add PID, memory, and CPU limits.

hardening_gaps.title: Docker base and APT inputs are mutable
hardening_gaps.condition: A later build of the same source commit can consume different upstream binaries.
hardening_gaps.recommendation: Pin the base image by digest, define the Node and npm toolchain, and adopt an update process for pinned OS inputs.

hardening_gaps.title: Secret scanning is not enforced
hardening_gaps.condition: No CI workflow, .gitleaks.toml, or secretlint configuration is tracked; current history scans found no high-signal secret.
hardening_gaps.recommendation: Add a small tracked secret-scanning policy and run it in protected CI.

hardening_gaps.title: Privileged accounts have no required second factor
hardening_gaps.condition: No administrator MFA mechanism was found; password, magic-link, session, and suspension behavior otherwise use Better Auth's protected paths.
hardening_gaps.recommendation: Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrator accounts before production use.
